apiKeys.help: Each key lets a storefront (e.g. the CommerceOS Sync WordPress plugin) call CommerceOS' cart recommendations API. Name each key for the storefront it's for, so you can revoke just that one later without affecting others.
apiKeys.newKey: New key (shown once -- copy it now)
apiKeys.none: No keys yet -- create one above.
apiKeys.shownOnce: This won't be shown again -- if you lose it, revoke it below and create a new one.
apiKeys.title: API keys

automation.subtitle: Rules that react to events
automation.text: Automations run from Message Center: choose an event, like an order shipping, and the message that goes out.

expiryAlert.title: Stock close to expiry
expiryAlert.subtitle: Every day, email a report of stock about to expire. It goes out through the Message Center rule “Stock close to expiry”, to the Stock email recipients from Notifications plus any extra emails on that rule.
expiryAlert.windowsHelp: One report per window. Windows don’t overlap: with 90 and 30 picked, the 90-day report lists stock with 31–90 days left.
expiryAlert.windowRequired: Pick at least one window to turn the report on.

fx.deleteMessage: Channels priced in it by conversion (not a manual override) stop pricing until a new rate is set.
fx.help: How much 1 unit of your default currency is worth in another currency -- used to price a sales channel running in that currency, unless a product/coupon has a manual override.
fx.ratePositive: Rate must be a positive number
fx.title: Exchange rates

integrations.subtitle: Connected external services. Configure sync schedules for each.

inventory.fefoAlert: Alert when product expires within 7 days
inventory.fefoText: First Expire, First Out — for perishable products
inventory.subtitle: Configure stock management behavior

jobs.intervalMin: Interval must be at least 1 minute
jobs.queuedHint: Queued — the scheduler runs it within a minute.
jobs.title: Scheduled Jobs

localization.languageHelp: The admin's language for users who haven't picked one, and the language new storefronts start in.
localization.subtitle: Currency, timezone, date formats
localization.title: Localization

lowStock.help: A product counts as low when its stock is above 0 and at or below this. Weighed products count in grams. A product can set its own value. 0 = never low.
lowStock.saveFailed: Failed to save low stock threshold
lowStock.title: Low stock

markup.help: Markup is profit as a % of cost (e.g. 300% markup means selling at 4x cost) -- no upper bound, unlike margin. Used to compute each product's recommended price from its cost price, unless its category has its own target markup set.
markup.label: Default target markup (%)
markup.title: Pricing & markup

notifications.channelOffersText: Marketplace offers that are not for sale, e.g. on Bol
notifications.importsText: Catalog, customer and order imports from your channels
notifications.otherText: Anything else CommerceOS tells you about
notifications.purchaseDocumentsText: Supplier documents and invoices read for purchase orders
notifications.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
notifications.recipientsHint: One address per line, up to 10.
notifications.stockText: Stock alerts such as the daily stock-close-to-expiry report
notifications.subtitle: Choose what shows in the bell and what is emailed. Emails go out through your email integration.

picking.listText: Pickers see each order’s items as a list and mark the whole order picked with one button -- no scanning. Items are scanned during packing.
picking.scanText: Pickers scan every item into a picking session before the order goes to packing.
picking.subtitle: How pickers work through orders before packing.
picking.title: Picking

pricing.subtitle: Default target markup used to compute recommended prices

recommendations.confidenceHelp: Bundle confidence — of orders containing a cart item, the % that must also contain a candidate before it's flagged bundle-worthy. Higher = fewer, more reliable bundle suggestions.
recommendations.confidenceRange: Bundle confidence must be between 0 and 100%.
recommendations.help: Tunes the pattern-mining behind "You may also like" and "Frequently bought together" on connected storefronts. Leave blank to use CommerceOS' defaults.
recommendations.lookbackHelp: Lookback window — how far back order history is mined. Shorter favors recent behavior over stale, since-discontinued patterns; longer gives more data for a seasonal or slow-moving catalog.
recommendations.supportHelp: Minimum support — orders a product pairing must appear in before it counts as a real pattern rather than coincidence. Raise this on a high-volume store to cut noise; keep it low on a small catalog or recommendations may disappear entirely.
recommendations.title: Cross-sell recommendations

sections.notificationsText: What shows in the bell and what is emailed

sections.shippingText: Default shipping provider, sender and return addresses
sections.appearanceText: Font, colours and spacing of the admin

security.subtitle: Sign-in and account protection
security.text: Sign-in, passwords and two-factor authentication are managed in your lm2 account, the login used for CommerceOS.

syncRules.help: Controls what quantity syncs to channels: no batches → ledger total · batches with no expiry → summed together · batches with an expiry → only the nearest-expiring batch's quantity, so channels sell through the oldest stock first.
syncRules.title: Sync & expiry rules

tax.subtitle: Tax classes and their per-country rates
tax.noDefaultClass: No default VAT class. Products without their own VAT class get no VAT rate, so their orders and quotes are at 0%. Choose one with Make default.
tax.defaultHasNoRate: The default VAT class {{name}} has no rate for {{country}}. Products without their own VAT class get no VAT rate. Add a {{country}} rate to it.
tax.noTaxCountry: No tax country is set, so products get no VAT rate. Set it under Store defaults.
tax.missingVat: No VAT rate for {{products}}: these lines are at 0%.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: How the admin looks for everyone in this shop. Changes show straight away so you can try them; nothing changes for others until you save.
appearance.readOnly: Only the shop owner or an admin can change the appearance.
appearance.accentHint: Buttons, links and the selected menu item.
appearance.sidebarHint: The sidebar text switches between light and dark to stay readable.
appearance.lowContrast: This accent colour is too light for white button text.

shipping.subtitle: The shipping provider packing preselects, and the addresses printed on labels.
shipping.noConnection: No shipping provider is connected yet.

deadLetters.title: Dead letters
deadLetters.intro: Events a consumer gave up on after its last retry. Retry one for the consumer that failed it, or discard it.
deadLetters.unknownConsumerHint: Dead-lettered before failure details were recorded. A retry reaches every consumer on this subject; each skips the event if it already processed it.
deadLetters.empty: No dead letters. Nothing is waiting.
deadLetters.emptyFiltered: No dead letters match these filters.
deadLetters.retryWarning: Some consumers re-read the current state instead of the event's snapshot (for example the Woo status push), so a retry acts on how things are now.

confirmRetry.title: Retry this event?
confirmRetry.messageFor: It is published again for {{consumer}} only, then removed from the dead letters. {{warning}}
confirmRetry.messageAll: It is published again for every consumer on {{subject}}; each skips it if it already processed it. Then it is removed from the dead letters. {{warning}}

confirmDiscard.title: Discard this event?
confirmDiscard.message: It is deleted without being processed. This cannot be undone.
